views.front: Rounded seat and curved upholstered back sit on a slender metal frame.
views.rear: Rear cushion, arm supports and frame remain connected.
views.detail: Fitted seat piping follows the cushion perimeter; pale fabric detail is restrained.
views.underside: Metal seat rails and four capped feet support the upholstery.
views.clay: Clay separates the curved back, tailored seat, arm pads and metal supports.
